pool.text: Stockholm was founded as a city by Swedish statesman Birger Jarl.
Stockholm's oldest preserved charter, the Letter of Privilege from the Privy Council, was issued.
A massacre of opposition figures called the Stockholm Bloodbath took place in the city.
Stockholm became the official capital of the Swedish empire.
Tre Kronor Castle burned down and was eventually replaced by Stockholm Palace.
A plague killed about 20,000 people which was 36 percent of the population.
The Stockholm Stock Exchange was founded as the largest stock exchange in the Nordic Countries.
The General Art and Industrial Exposition was held and drew international attention.
The Stockholm Metro opened and is well known for its station decor.
The Stockholm International Film Festival became an annual film festival held each year.
The Royal National City Park was founded as the world's first legally protected national urban park.
Stockholm was named European Capital of Culture.
Stockholm put a congestion pricing system in use on a permanent basis.
The video game Minecraft was created in Stockholm by Markus Notch Persson.
The city was granted the European Green Capital Award by the EU Commission.
Operations began for the City Line, which is an environmentally certified commuter train tunnel project.
Stockholm's population increased by 1,477 during the year.
